what: the hide of a gigantic wild boar made into a coat: a long, thick, rough hide of dark brown-black skin, covered all over with long stiff dark bristles that stand up in a ridge down its back like a row of spear shafts, with the boar's own head kept on as a hood at the top, the snout pointing up, two great curved ivory-white tusks curling out of its jaws.

a ridge of long stiff bristles

two curved ivory tusks
